game_identity.player_fantasy: Be the last maintenance runner carrying unstable charge from a central core to failing relays fast enough to keep the network alive.
game_identity.central_interaction: Route, recharge, carry, and transfer charge between a central core and four decaying relay beacons.

playable_loop: Move -> recharge at core -> choose upper/lower passage -> carry charge -> touch beacon to transfer -> manage beacon decay -> choose next route -> stabilize all four or black out -> retry
technology_stack: Plain HTML/CSS/JavaScript Canvas; local/offline browser; no dependencies
current_milestone: Decisionful Routing Slice: deepen the accepted relay-maintenance loop so at least two traversable route/passage classes have materially different measured travel costs, all required relays remain reachable, exact-composition WON feasibility plus established BLACKOUT/retry semantics are preserved, and the route-shaping cue is VISUALLY INSPECTED on the exact accepted browser composition. Human/fresh-player PLAYTESTED evidence remains a validation gap and is required before claims about intuitive choice, fairness, tension, balance, or fun.
